blocks.text: Inflammatory response infections ke khilaf sab se aam non-specific jawabon mein se aik hai. Infected ya zakhmi cells chemical signals (kimiyai ishare), maslan histamines aur prostaglandins, chhorte hain. Yeh chemicals us jagah ki khoon ki naliyon ko phaila dete hain. Is tarah zakhm ya infection ki jagah capillaries mein khoon ka bahao barh jata hai. Capillaries zyada permeable (aar paar rasne wali) bhi ho jati hain. Nateeje mein us jagah surkhi, soojan aur garmi paida hoti hai. Is haalat ko inflammation (sozish) kehte hain. Garmi us jagah ko microbes ke barhne ke liye na-munasib bana deti hai. Yeh zakhm bharne mein bhi madad deti hai aur white blood cells ki harkat barhati hai. Mazeed phagocytes (macrophages aur neutrophils) khoon se nikal kar soje hue tissue mein aate hain aur microbes ko nigal lete hain. Monocytes aa kar microbes ko maarne wale chemicals chhorte hain aur phir macrophages murda microbes, cells aur malbe (debris) ki safai karte hain. Inflammatory response aksar itna taqatwar hota hai ke microbes ka phelao rok deta hai.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Kuch infections mein banne wali peep (pus) murda ya marte hue neutrophils, toote hue tissue cells aur murda pathogens ka mixture hoti hai. Kuch soorton mein (maslan arthritis, jorron ka dard) infection ya zakhm ke baghair bhi inflammation ho jati hai. Yeh ghalat rukh wale (misdirected) immune response ki misal hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle hisse mein pin skin mein chubh kar bacteria andar le jati hai aur cells chemical signals chhorte hain. Doosre hisse mein soojan hai: phagocytes aur maya khoon ki nali se nikal kar us jagah aate hain. Teesre hisse mein phagocytes bacteria aur cells ka malba nigal lete hain.

blocks.prompt: Soji hui jagah surkh, phooli hui aur garam kyun hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Histamines aur prostaglandins khoon ki naliyan phailate hain (zyada khoon: surkhi aur garmi) aur capillaries ko zyada permeable banate hain (maya tissue mein: soojan).

items: Infected ya zakhmi cells histamines aur prostaglandins chhorte hain: naliyan phailti, capillaries rasti, surkhi-soojan-garmi (inflammation).
Phagocytes aa kar microbes nigalte hain; macrophages safai karte hain.
Peep murda neutrophils, tissue cells aur pathogens ka mixture hai; arthritis misdirected immune response hai.
